Field.Label: Print all BLE messages to the info log for easier BLE debugging.
BLE packets older than this are discarded, since their sensor values are stale (ex: queued while the plugin was stopped). Increase it to process longer backlogs. Leave blank to use the default.

Events (ex: button presses) from BLE packets older than this do not fire triggers, so delayed events don't run actions late. Ignored events are logged as warnings. Increase it if events are ignored due to relay delays, or decrease it to reject delayed events sooner. Leave blank to use the default.
